description.en: Trachonitis, Batanaea and Auranitis, with Gaulanitis and the Paneas district (part of the former domain of Zenodorus), between the Decapolis and Damascus. Iturea proper, in the Lebanon, was not part of it.
description.ar: تراخونيتس وباتانيا وأورانيتس، مع الجولان (غولانيتيس) ومنطقة بانياس (جزء من أملاك زينودوروس السابقة)، بين الديكابوليس ودمشق. ولم تكن إيطورية بمعناها الضيق، في لبنان، جزءاً منها.
description.he: טרכוניטיס, בטניאה ואורניטיס, עם גולניטיס ומחוז פניאס (חלק מתחום זנודורוס לשעבר), בין הדקאפוליס לדמשק. יטוריה עצמה, שבלבנון, לא הייתה חלק ממנה.

sources.quote: Philip should rule Trachonitis, Batanaea, and Auranitis (the area between the Decapolis and Damascus)
Augustus gave Iturea to Herod the Great, who in turn bequeathed it to his son Philip
but Batanea, and Trachonitis, and Auranitis, and certain parts of Zeno's house about Jamnia, with a revenue of a hundred talents, were made subject to Philip
He also gave Gaulonitis, and Trachonitis, and Paneas to Philip
Iturea proper cannot therefore have belonged to the domain of Philip
The Itureans proper had their dwelling in the Lebanon
